fields.summary: TC-MTA-005: Market Time Adjustment - Middle Original Leg Delayed More Than 15 Minutes - Non-Original but No LCO Unless Trip Boundaries Impacted

content.text: Linked Story: Market Time Adjustment

Precondition: A crew member has an original middle leg of the trip (not first, not last) assigned in V0. The leg is delayed by more than 15 minutes. Trip start and trip end boundaries are NOT impacted. isOriginal = TRUE initially.
TEST STEPS
Step
Action
Test Data
Expected Result
Set up a crew member with a multi-leg trip where the middle leg is original on flight 234 HOU-AUS in V0
Trip: Leg1=123 DAL-HOU (first), Leg2=234 HOU-AUS (middle, isOriginal=TRUE), Leg3=345 AUS-MCO (last). V0.
Multi-leg trip with original middle leg is set up successfully in V0
Apply a market time adjustment delay of more than 15 minutes to the middle leg only - trip start and trip end are not impacted
Delay > 15 minutes on Leg2 only, trip start (Leg1) unchanged, trip end (Leg3) unchanged, changeType=Market Time Adjustment
Market time adjustment is applied to the middle leg only without changing trip boundaries
Navigate to COA Search App and retrieve the COA record for the crew member
COA Search App - search by crew ID and trip
COA record is retrieved successfully
Verify the middle leg is treated as Non-Original after more than 15-minute delay
isOriginal flag in COA record for the middle leg
isOriginal = FALSE. Delay of more than 15 minutes changes original status to Non-Original for the middle leg.
Verify no LCO is generated because the trip start and trip end boundaries are not impacted by this middle leg delay
LCO field in COA record for the middle leg
LCO: Not Generated. Middle leg delay with no trip boundary impact does not trigger LCO even though leg is Non-Original.
Verify the first and last legs of the trip retain their original isOriginal status unchanged
isOriginal flag for Leg1 and Leg3 in COA record
Leg1 isOriginal = TRUE and Leg3 isOriginal = TRUE. Only the delayed middle leg changes to Non-Original.
